### ITERATION 1 CONSTRAINTS
[O]: Strictly limit objective findings to explicit measurements, observations, or physical exam results documented in the transcript. Do not infer objective status (e.g., "within normal limits," "no abnormalities") from patient's subjective reports or the absence of reported symptoms. If no objective data is present for a category, omit it.

### ITERATION 2 CONSTRAINTS
[P]: Ensure all planned actions, responsibilities, and follow-up instructions are accurately attributed to the correct party (patient or provider) as explicitly stated in the transcript. Do not reverse or misassign who initiates contact or performs a task.
